final_message:
I fixed two bugs in `wrap` in `src/wrap.py`. I haven't run it or any tests.

- **Off-by-one:** the check was `> width - 1`, so lines wrapped one character early. A line of exactly `width` characters was never allowed. It's now `> width`.
- **Empty first line:** a first word longer than `width` pushed an empty string onto `lines`. The check now only wraps when the current line is non-empty (`cur and ...`). An over-long word now gets its own line instead.

I left over-long words unsplit, so a line can still be longer than `width` when a single word is. If you want those words broken up, tell me.
